indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.evidenceText: The Price of Travel methodology states that the Hostel Index price is per night, including taxes and fees, for one person in a shared dorm room, averaged over a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023. The Rome row names Palladini Hostel Rome and lists $25.32.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; Hostel Index 2023
indexObservation.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world Rome Italy Hostel Index dorm bed price
indexObservation.reason: Exact Rome row and explicit index methodology satisfy the one-person shared-dorm, nightly, tax-included contract.

currentBenchmark.evidenceText: The exact-property Hostelworld result identifies Palladini Rome in Rome and states that taxes are not included, but it provides no numeric current nightly shared-dorm price in the search result. Other returned listings either exposed a private/room-level quote or only offered a button to view dates, so no strict current benchmark was selected.
currentBenchmark.searchQuery: Palladini Hostel Rome Rome shared dorm bed one person nightly price taxes fees
currentBenchmark.reason: not_found: the single allowed current-property search did not expose a numeric, non-sale, one-person shared-dorm nightly price.
